class.name: SteamFriends
class.brief_description: Reads cached friends and manages individual Rich Presence keys.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.friends]. Use [method list] for the signed-in account's immediate friends and [SteamPresence] for managed status. The individual Rich Presence calls operate on the signed-in account's keys.

method.name: clear_rich_presence
method.description: Clears one Rich Presence [param key] and preserves the account's other keys. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] when Steam accepts the update. The Game provider reserves the [code]connect[/code] key for its join route.

method.name: list
method.description: Returns the current cached immediate friends as a read-only typed collection. A successful result can contain an empty array. An inactive or unavailable Steam client returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the active client exposes the Steam Friends interface on the main thread.

method.name: rich_presence
method.description: Returns the signed-in account's cached value for [param key], or an empty string when the key is absent or the query is unavailable.

method.name: set_rich_presence
method.description: Sets one Rich Presence [param key] to [param value]. Both must be nonempty UTF-8 strings within Steam's byte limits. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] when Steam accepts the update. Setting a managed key explicitly removes it from [SteamPresence] ownership. Use [method clear_rich_presence] to remove a key. The Game provider reserves [code]connect[/code].
